title: Welcome to Pydantic | Pydantic Docs
text:
Welcome to Pydantic Documentation for version: v2.13.4. Pydantic is the most widely used data validation library for Python. Fast and extensible, Pydantic plays nicely with your linters/IDE/brain. Define how data should be in pure, canonical Python 3.9+; validate it with Pydantic.
